data.comment:
# Comfy Vidu Q2- Text to Video

Generate high-quality 1080p videos from text prompts with Vidu Q2 model Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_vidu_q2_t2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: An elderly woman receives an unexpected letter from home. Her hands tremble as she opens the envelope. Mid-way through reading, her lips twitch into a faint smile, then her eyes well up with tears, expressing a sense of profound relief and bittersweet joy. Cinematic lighting, 8k, emotional storytelling.
